At 5 months, Theo's just about a month out from the window — Health Canada says around 6 months, and the readiness signs to watch for are sitting with minimal support, showing interest in food, and good head control. When he's ticking those boxes, iron-rich foods like pureed meat or iron-fortified cereal are the ones to lead with.
